title: Positive-genus intermediate covers prevent loss of monodromy under rational substitution

statement.quantifiers: An algebraically closed characteristic-zero field k, finite Galois L/k(t) with every nontrivial intermediate extension represented by a positive-genus projective curve, and nonconstant f in k(X).
statement.assertion: Base change t=f preserves the Galois group; in the explicit T^3+T-f^2 detector, irreducibility plus nonsquare discriminant gives full geometric S3.
assumptions: Require every relevant intermediate field, not just genus of the total covering curve.
Proper smooth curve compactification and nonconstant generic-line restriction.
Explicit cubic uses independent elliptic root and discriminant-resolvent obstructions.

inputs: Galois covering/intermediate genus evidence and a nonconstant rational substitution.
outputs: Full monodromy after substitution; separate etale localization at discriminant.
interface.precision: Exact function-field argument source-reported; general field-compositum proof needs specialist review.
costs: No effective arbitrary-cover recognizer or group acquisition algorithm supplied.
Localization and inverse-variable output charged separately.

proof_mechanism: Any nontrivial field intersection would put a positive-genus curve function field into k(X).
Restrict the resulting rational map from P^n to a generic P1; properness and Riemann-Hurwitz exclude it.
For the cubic, a root would map to y^2=x^3+x, while a square discriminant maps to W^2=-4-27T^4, both genus one.
An irreducible cubic with nonsquare discriminant has S3, then inverting Delta gives a finite etale cover.
obstructions: Genus-zero s^2=t loses degree at t=X^2, so no unconditional regular-extension shortcut.
Monodromy/real surjectivity does not imply rational surjectivity.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Identify every degree-loss intermediate cover and validate its positive genus before transferring geometric monodromy.

review.source_reported: Source claims complete written arguments and scoped finite checks; independent audit receipts or executable replay packages not supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
